description: The first word after a clause that a command inside the text ended, with no sentence mark written there: one of the auxiliaries that are stressed as a sentence's first word, and a question word, whose sentence has its question mark sent as a period; after a rate, a voice, a definition, a pause and a mode command, with a sentence mark written before the command for comparison, and in the spelling mode. Written before any export and not edited afterwards.

entries.text: The old gate [:rate 200] is shut now.
The old gate [:nb] was shut then.
Both doors [:dv ap 180] were open all day.
The boys [:comma 100] had gone home, and so had we.
The rain [:mode math on] will stop soon.
The old gate. [:rate 200] Is it shut now?
They asked us [:rate 200] where is the key?
Is the gate [:nh] where it was?
The gate [:mode spell on] is [:mode spell off] is shut.
[:mode spell on] The gate [:rate 200] was shut.
[:mode spell on] We ask [:rate 200] who is it?
